busco --version > busco_version.txt

busco --offline --in "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78854170/inputs/dataset_d44e2748-2746-4b0e-b569-23b7cb8e30da.dat" --lineage_dataset db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out Animals_Ggal --out_path runs --cpu 4 --force
busco --offline --in "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78854170/inputs/dataset_07e64717-d9d4-4d2a-970d-0c38d0c9fb3f.dat" --lineage_dataset db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out Fungi_Ncra --out_path runs --cpu 4 --force
busco --offline --in "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78854170/inputs/dataset_0fd62599-5d0c-4c2e-a858-926793d75493.dat" --lineage_dataset db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out Fungi_Scer --out_path runs --cpu 4 --force
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
labels = ["Animals_Cele", "Animals_Ggal", "Fungi_Ncra", "Fungi_Scer"]
sets = []
status_maps = {}
for label in labels:
    table = Path("runs") / label / "run_eukaryota_odb10" / "full_table.tsv"
    if not table.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing BUSCO full table: {table}")
    statuses = {}
    for line in table.read_text().splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        fields = line.split("\t")
        if len(fields) >= 2:
            statuses[fields[0]] = fields[1]
    status_maps[label] = statuses
    sets.append({busco_id for busco_id, status in statuses.items() if status == "Complete"})
shared = set.intersection(*sets)
with open("shared_complete_single_copy.tsv", "w") as out:
    out.write("BUSCO_id\tAnimals_Cele\tAnimals_Ggal\tFungi_Ncra\tFungi_Scer\n")
    for busco_id in sorted(shared):
        out.write(busco_id + "\t" + "\t".join(status_maps[label][busco_id] for label in labels) + "\n")
with open("busco_run_summaries.txt", "w") as out:
    out.write(Path("busco_version.txt").read_text())
    out.write("\nLINEAGE CONFIGURATION\n")
    out.write(Path("db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10/dataset.cfg").read_text())
    for label in labels:
        matches = list((Path("runs") / label).glob("short_summary.specific.*.txt"))
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f"expected one specific-lineage summary for {label}, found {len(matches)}")
        out.write(f"\n===== {label} =====\n")
        out.write(matches[0].read_text())
PY
